explication: Claude Trading Skills is a toolkit of standalone, human-directed trading and investing skills—not an automated execution platform. Its user workflow is to review market conditions and risk, optionally research candidates and plan trades, manage portfolio decisions, then journal closed trades and review performance. The README also documents a separate edge-research pipeline and skill-generation/improvement tooling. The workflow manifests and most skill implementations were not sampled, so the graph preserves documented capabilities without asserting unverified inter-skill calls or ordering.
